LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Manual.Lead: A court historian for the colony. It records facts; it does not hand out bonuses. Who worked, who fought, who held the loot — careers and medals are derived from those facts later.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Manual.How.L1: Use the Archive button on the bottom tab bar.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Manual.How.L2: Pick a category on the left, then click a card for detail.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Manual.How.L3: A selected pawn has compact Archive and Career inspect tabs.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Manual.Concepts.Blu: The ledger stores what happened. Quality is computed later.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Manual.Concepts.L1: Facts: who crafted what, who killed whom, where they stayed — written at the moment it happens.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Manual.Concepts.L2: Grades: professional level, titles, medals. Changing the rules does not rewrite history.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Manual.Concepts.L3: Live = who is present now. Archive = cumulative history. Cryptosleep does not inflate the headcount.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Manual.Concepts.L4: Events from before this mod was enabled cannot be backfilled. Empty early-game cells are normal.

LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Manual.Career.L2: High enough level unlocks titles; senior ranks need exams, a thesis and a defense.
LanguageData.PersonalChronicle.UI.Manual.Career.L3: Specialization can change work speed or quality. Manufacturing is the complete loop of the twelve majors.
